claims.claim: Intl.NumberFormat('he-IL', { style: 'currency', currency: 'ILS' }).format(1234.5) returns "\u200f1,234.50\u00a0\u200f\u20aa": the string carries two U+200F RTL marks and a U+00A0 non-breaking space, not the bare "1,234.50 \u20aa" it appears to be.
